question: How many repeat customers were there in January–June 2025 and in July–December 2025? Evaluate repeat status separately within each reporting period, then say which half had more.

action.query:
WITH jan_jun_orders AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2025-07-01'
      AND IS_CANCELLED = FALSE
),
jul_dec_orders AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER
    WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-07-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
      AND IS_CANCELLED = FALSE
),
jan_jun_repeat AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM jan_jun_orders
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
),
jul_dec_repeat AS (
    SELECT CUSTOMER_ID
    FROM jul_dec_orders
    GROUP BY CUSTOMER_ID
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jan_jun_repeat) AS repeat_customers_jan_jun,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jul_dec_repeat) AS repeat_customers_jul_dec
action.metrics: repeat customers in Jan–Jun 2025, repeat customers in Jul–Dec 2025
repeat customers in Jan–Jun 2025, repeat customers in Jul–Dec 2025
action.answer: There were 94,512 repeat customers in January–June 2025 and 96,095 repeat customers in July–December 2025. Repeat status was evaluated separately within each half-year period, counting customers with more than one order in that period (excluding cancelled orders). July–December 2025 had more repeat customers than January–June 2025, with a difference of 1,583 customers. Unit: unique customers per period. Population: all non-cancelled orders in 2025.
action.reason: Both periods were evaluated independently for repeat status, and the counts show a higher number of repeat customers in the second half of 2025.
